title: plugins.delta-update
description: Delta Update Engine plugin configuration for tauri.conf.json. Unknown keys are ignored (with a startup warning), so this schema stays forward-compatible.

config_version.description: Configuration format version. Bump it only for breaking changes; older configs fail with E_CONFIG_MIGRATION_REQUIRED.

endpoint.description: Manifest URL. HTTPS is required outside local loopback development.

signing_public_keys.description: Trusted minisign public keys. Any one of them may sign a manifest; embed more than one to allow rotation.

auto_check.description: Run check + prepare in the background after setup.

auto_apply.description: Replace the prepared update when the app exits. Explicit opt-in.

auto_confirm.description: Confirm the new version as healthy after the first window loads.

confirm_delay_ms.description: Delay before auto_confirm. 0 confirms as soon as the window loads.

check_interval_secs.description: Periodic check + prepare interval in seconds. Omitted or null disables it; the minimum is 60.

channel.description: Update channel compared with the manifest channel.

signing_endpoint.description: Signed-URL service for a private bucket. Must be HTTPS.

allowed_hosts.description: Host allowlist for object downloads. Null allows any HTTPS host.

crash_loop_threshold.description: Unconfirmed starts allowed before the committed update is rolled back.

exit_grace_period_secs.description: A clean exit after this many seconds discounts one unconfirmed start. 0 discounts any clean exit.

install_dir.description: Install root when auto-detection fails (portable builds). Must be absolute.

staging_dir.description: Staging directory. Must be absolute and outside install_dir.

journal_dir.description: Journal and lock directory. Must be absolute and outside install_dir.

staging_size_limit.description: Staging area limit in bytes. Null uses 2 GiB.

max_patch_file_size.description: Files above this size skip the delta pipeline. Null uses 256 MiB.

patch_memory_factor.description: Patch memory budget = file size x this factor. Null uses 2.5.

manifest_max_bytes.description: Manifest size limit in bytes. Null uses 8 MiB.

allow_insecure_http.description: Allow plain HTTP strictly for loopback hosts. Local development only.

proxy.description: HTTP/SOCKS proxy URL for enterprise networks.

headers.description: Extra headers for manifest and signature requests only.

signing_headers.description: Extra headers for the signed-URL service only, kept apart from `headers`.
